subject: How to create and interact with a dynamic number of tabPanels?

messages.author: 7de7055149e31f11
messages.subject: How to create and interact with a dynamic number of tabPanels?
parts:
I'm having trouble creating a dynamic number of tabs in our shiny application. I want the end product to look like this


 

 

I want multiple “model 1”, “model 2”, …  tabs, where each tab has its own shiny UI elements that contain unique information. I also want the ability to on-the-fly add more tabs or remove old tabs (through the buttons on the bottom).

 

The problem lies in that last part. I can’t figure out a way for the user to add or remove new UI elements as needed. This is also complicated by the fact that this app uses persistent data storage – if the user made and saved 5 tabs the first time they used the app, I want those same 5 tabs to appear when they use the app the next time. We already have a method of persistent data storage working (no need to worry about that right now), but I cannot figure out a way to generate tabs based on previously saved data.

 

I’ve tried creating tabs dynamically with do.call, and I am able to generate a variable number of tabs. However, populating each of those tabPanels with uniquely named textInputs has proved to be the challenge. And even then, interacting with those textInputs in order to save the data has given me the most trouble.

 

Is there a way to implement this kind of feature in a shiny app?

 

Thank you,

Ryan
